name: goal-core
summary: Explicit mission-goal management. Stores the active goal in .pi/GOAL.yaml and writes a contribution file for context-sieve to inject (survives compaction). /goal sets, shows, or clears the goal. Also enforces the unattended ceiling (PI_KIT_CEILING_*, or /away): the first of turns, money or wall time reached parks the run, and a terminal bell/OSC 9 rings for a card left unanswered a minute, a long run ending, or a park.
